title: Fama Fraternitatis
subtitle: or, a Discovery of the Fraternity of the most Laudable Order of the Rosy Cross
author: Rosicrucian Manifestos
imprint: First printed at Cassel, 1614. Translated by Thomas Vaughan, 1652; in A. E. Waite, The Real History of the Rosicrucians, London: George Redway, 1887
edition: Vaughan's translation (1652) as A. E. Waite printed it, 1887
note: Vaughan's English as Waite printed it, the text Paul Case quotes, with Waite's spelling and his notes. Set from the sacred-texts.com transcription, read word by word against the 1887 print; its slips are corrected.
